summary: ALRAFIDAIN KULTURFORUM I NORGE (org. no. 917 017 433) is an association (FLI) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2016-04-14. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Mohammed Al Thamdawy; board chair: Mohammed Al Thamdawy.
